definition: מְדִינָה noun feminine province (an Aramaic word, compare Syriac , Arabic city ) ** compare also Old Aramaic מדינתא city , Palmyrene מדיתא city , suffix מדיתהון , plural מדינתא SAC 70 Lzb 306 Cooke 266 . — Esth 1:1 + 28 t.; plural מְדִינוֺת 1Kgs 20:14 + 23 t.; — a district of an empire, 1. districts of realm of Ahab with שׂרים over them 1Kgs 20:14 ; 1Kgs 20:15 ; 1Kgs 20:17 ; 1Kgs 20:19 . 2. of the Babylonian empire: Ezek 19:8 ; Dan 8:2 (of Elam); שָׂרָתִי בַּמְּדִינוֺת princess among the provinces Lam 1:1 (of Judea). 3. of the Persian empire Esth 1:1 + often; one of which was Palestine, Neh 1:3 the returning exiles, בְּנֵי הַמְּדִינָה children of the province Ezra 2:1 ; Neh 7:6 having רָאשֵׁי הַמְּדִינָה Neh 11:3 . 4. provinces in general Eccl 2:8 ; Eccl 5:7 בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּי מְדִינָה in the fat places of the province Dan 11:24 (fertile regions, probably Egypt; other translations see in Bev .)
definition_html:
BDB1927 [H4082]

BDB1926 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB1928

מְדִינָה noun feminine province (an Aramaic word, compare Syriac , Arabic city)

**compare also Old Aramaic מדינתא city, Palmyrene מדיתא city, suffix מדיתהון, plural מדינתא SAC70 Lzb306 Cooke266. — Esth 1:1 + 28 t.; plural מְדִינוֺת 1Kgs 20:14 + 23 t.; — a district of an empire,
1. districts of realm of Ahab with שׂרים over them 1Kgs 20:14; 1Kgs 20:15; 1Kgs 20:17; 1Kgs 20:19.
2. of the Babylonian empire: Ezek 19:8; Dan 8:2 (of Elam); שָׂרָתִי בַּמְּדִינוֺת princess among the provinces Lam 1:1 (of Judea).
3. of the Persian empire Esth 1:1 + often; one of which was Palestine, Neh 1:3 the returning exiles, בְּנֵי הַמְּדִינָה children of the province Ezra 2:1; Neh 7:6 having רָאשֵׁי הַמְּדִינָה Neh 11:3.
4. provinces in general Eccl 2:8; Eccl 5:7 בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּי מְדִינָה in the fat places of the province Dan 11:24 (fertile regions, probably Egypt; other translations see in Bev.)
